title: Geometric fibre exchange germ formula
statement: Let Lambda be a commutative ring and F a sheaf of Lambda-modules on X_et [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Let s:Spec Omega -> Y be a geometric point with Omega algebraically closed [def-weil-geometric-point], and (g':X' -> X,f':X' -> Spec Omega,f:X -> Y,s) a Cartesian square [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square]. Let Theta be any module map from (f_*F)_s to sections of g'^*F on X', such that on each pointed neighbourhood germ it is the unit for g' followed by restriction along the lift with projections (f' followed by the marked point,g') and the identity. There is an isomorphism b from the identity-point stalk of f'_*g'^*F to these sections, such that stalk(exchange) followed by b equals the canonical inverse-image source stalk comparison followed by Theta [def-weil-pbc-underived-exchange]. No integrality, properness, or invertibility of Theta is assumed.

proof.text: Identify the source stalk using the inverse-image comparison. The terminal germ on Spec Omega is invertible by the strict henselian section-stalk comparison. Identify terminal sections of f'_*g'^*F with sections on X' through preservation of the terminal object by base change; their composite gives b.

On a germ represented on (V,v), expand the pushforward-unit identity for the exchange mate. Pulling along v and then restricting to X' gives the inverse-image unit for g' followed by the iterated pullback lift with the specified two projections. The assumed formula for Theta is exactly this expression. Every source germ has a representative, so the equality holds as module maps.

theorem geometricFibreExchange_germs
    (Λ : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing Λ]
    {X' X Y : Scheme.{u}} {Ω : Type u} [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω]
    {g' : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ Spec (.of Ω)} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    {s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Y} (sq : IsPullback g' f' f s)
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ))
    (Θ : (pointSmallEtale s).sheafFiber.obj ((f)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj F) ⟶
      ((g')^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj F).obj.obj (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X'))))
    (hΘ : ∀ (V : Y.Etale) (v : (pointSmallEtale s).fiber.obj V)
      (z : F.obj.obj (op (f.Etale.obj V))),
      Θ.hom ((pointSmallEtale s).toPresheafFiber V v
        ((f)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj F).obj z) =
      (geometricFibreSectionRestriction Λ sq.toCommSq F V v).hom z) :
    ∃ b : (pointSmallEtale (𝟙 (Spec (.of Ω)))).sheafFiber.obj
        ((f')_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj ((g')^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj F)) ≅
          ((g')^*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj F).obj.obj (op (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X'))),
      (pointSmallEtale (𝟙 (Spec (.of Ω)))).sheafFiber.map
          ((baseChangeMap (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) sq.toCommSq).app F) ≫ b.hom =
        (geometricPointSourceStalkIso Λ s ((f)_*[ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ].obj F)).hom ≫ Θ
